content.text: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot This helps protect our community. Learn more On the greatest question of our era: Celebrities Fake Sometimes? The first 1,000 people to use the link will get a 1 month free trial of Skillshare https://skl.sh/sarahz08231 ------ Support me: Merch: https://standard.tv/sarahz Patreon: / sarahz Check out my cowriter Emily: / @ladyemilypresents Music: Ooyy - Colorplast Zoë Blade - Walking in the Rain Support Foundation of Hope: https://foundationofhope.net/ Some various queer art that I've been enjoying lately: I Was A Teenage Exocolonist - amazing and super queer game developed by a small Canadian indie studio. Really fun deckbuilding mechanic. Designed to be super replayable. Absurdly good What Happens Next - Indie webcomic about having committed a terrible and very public crime as a child, having to live with it now, and also spending your days on Tumblr. Really good. Really disturbing. I'm so excited for it to update again. Misericorde: Volume One - Murder mystery VN with medieval nuns. I don't know if I'm just Locked Tomb brained but I've been seeking out queer nun content lately. Something about the art style here really tickles my brain. Yazeba's Bed and Breakfast - Genre-bending and very trans TTRPG about a B&B owned by a witch and housing various misfits. Really difficult for me to accurately describe other than to say it's unlike any TTRPG I've played before and to please check out this game.
